Body is pure map/loop consolidation theory (six-phase value cycle, feedback-control naming, verification/absorption/outcome laws) -- grepped the body (lines 1-54) this session for 'Claude Code'/'Cowork'/'claude.ai'/'Claude Desktop'/'[Skill:': zero hits (exit 1); zero round-number stats (95/85/80%: exit 1); zero `{{prompt:` or fenced blocks (exit 1, matches body-view signal has_prompt_blocks:false); zero F-Secure mentions. Drift rule platform_and_boundaries §45 re-read at current wording via `node curriculum/evals/scripts/rule.js platform_and_boundaries 45`: its subject is audit-tooling parser coverage (audit-eval-coverage.js's sub-lettered-rule parsing, check-instance-evidence.js's fail-open-on-unknown-shape corollary) -- a rule about how OUR OWN eval instruments read records, not a constraint this lecture's prose could violate; body carries no ledger, no detector output, no audit-tooling claim of any kind. Applied it to myself instead: emitted an explicit N/A row (not a silent omission) for platform §45 in this ledger, and ran `check-instance-evidence.js` against my own output before reporting, which is exactly the round-trip the corollary asks for. Two coverage gaps found in the prior instance at this path (dated before shape_hash existed): it was missing platform_and_boundaries rules 40-44 and 46-49 entirely (10 of 67 rules silently absent from its ledger) -- all ten are meta-tooling rules (hook portability, tmux socket discipline, killed-wrapper diagnosis, git-log-on-deleted-file, freshness-check-input-enumeration, judge-performance-regression-diagnosis, bench-silence, invisible-instruction-decay) with no lecture-body surface to bind to; re-derived and added as N/A this run so the ledger is now the full 67. No blocking findings.
